title: REST integrations: consumed REST (client, methods, inputs/outputs, structures, headers) and exposed REST (service, methods, inputs/outputs) on ODC and O11, with the credential refusal on ODC

capabilities.title: Consume a REST API: client, methods, inputs/outputs by placement, request/response structures, headers (generated by rest-consume)
capabilities.summary: GENERATOR FIRST: {"op":"rest-consume","data":{"name":"<Client>","methods":[{"name":"<Method>","url":"https://host/path/{id=1}?q=v"}]}} writes the whole consumed REST integration in one call, open or authenticated (auth bearer|basic|apiKey|oauth2: never a credential in the model); the recipe and the options are in guidance. By hand (op rest or raw verbs): IRestClient with BaseURL (and the authentication MODE), IRestStructure(s) for request/response under the client (nested: the child structure first, then its name as the attribute DataType), IRestAction with HTTPMethod and URLPath (the query string is written inside URLPath; each {param} needs a UrlPlacement input), IRestActionInput/IRestActionOutput by placement (Url/Body/Header, OriginalName for a non-identifier header name), a client header as IExtendedProperty (Property/Value). A server action calls the method with IExecuteServerActionNode Action = IRestAction:<Name> and reads <Node>.Response.<Attribute>.

route.operation: op rest-consume {name, baseUrl?, methods:[{name, url, verb?, sample?, request?, resource?, action?, headers?, optional?, timeout?}], expose?, errors? {exception, status}, auth? {type, in, name, tokenUrl, scope, cacheMinutes}, headers?, settings? {baseUrl}, timeout?, correlationHeader?, callbacks? {before, after}} (api --op rest-consume): the whole integration from URLs in one call, open or authenticated; op rest {client, methods, structures, remove, breaks} (api --op rest) only to declare a client by hand; deliver with studio_deliver / o11_deliver

capabilities.guidance: rest-consume writes in one call, deterministically, the IRestClient and its IRestAction(s), the response IRestStructure(s) inferred from a JSON sample (the delivery GETs each url once; offline give "sample"), a public structure per resource, the mapping (the platform's own, never a For Each) and a public service action per method, Verb+Client+Object (GetBrasilApiFeriados), that raises <Client>Error with logging on any failure (one that changes data checks the signed-in user first); idempotent, collision-safe, every element and signature in the receipt. AUTHENTICATED AND CUSTOMIZED APIs, same op, both lanes: auth {type: bearer|basic|apiKey (in header|query, name)|oauth2 (tokenUrl, scope, cacheMinutes)} never carries a credential (REST_CREDENTIALS_NOT_IN_MODEL): the generator creates the empty secret site properties (O11) / settings (ODC) that hold it (basic: on O11 user and password, encoded at runtime by the system extension BinaryData, whose reference op the delivery adds; on ODC the Base64 of user:password), the client's OnBeforeRequest reads them (oauth2: a token client <Client>Auth and a private Get<Client>AccessToken the platform caches), and the receipt's configure lists what the user fills in Service Center or the ODC Portal; headers {Name: literal} on every request, methods[].headers {Name: literal|{input}}, methods[].optional, correlationHeader, settings {baseUrl:true} (per environment), timeout, errors.status {"404": "<Exception>"} (OnAfterResponse: any status from 400 raises <Client>Error with the status and a body excerpt), callbacks {before|after: {steps}} for the model's own steps after the recipe. An authenticated API is never sampled: give sample. Prefer rest-consume: never write the client, its structures, the public structures, the mapping or the wrapper actions by hand. Addressing outside the creating job: IRestClient:<Client>, IRestAction:<Method>, IRestStructure:<Structure>, children by path ($parent/<Child>, $client/#IExtendedProperty[n]). Calling the method is logic (front A): IExecuteServerActionNode with Action = IRestAction:<Name>, one argument per method input ($call/<Input> Value), output read as <Node>.Response.<Attribute>. Renaming a method keeps its callers by key (ODC, rest-consume-lifecycle). Credentials are not model data on ODC (see integration.rest-credentials-in-model); the model keeps AuthenticationType only.

capabilities.title: OpenAPI or Swagger document import: only the chosen operations become methods
capabilities.summary: The openapi block of the op {path, sha256, operations: [operationId | "VERB /path"], external?} imports the chosen operations of an OpenAPI/Swagger document through the platform's own importer, offline: the deliver pins the document and its external $ref files. ODC headless in the kernel; O11 through the bridge (integration_import) inside o11_deliver.

route.operation: op rest {client: {name}, openapi: {path, sha256, operations}} (api --op rest, shapes.openapi); deliver with studio_deliver (ODC, headless) or o11_deliver (O11, bridge integration_import)

capabilities.guidance: Name the operations exactly (operationId, or the verb and the path as the document writes them); a wrong one is OPENAPI_OPERATION_NOT_FOUND with the list of what exists. The client is named by the op (the platform names it after the title). Add more methods by hand in the same op (methods) or later. Without a document, declare the methods with the op rest (integration.rest-consume).

limits.text: An existing client gets new operations through GetSwaggerInfo + ToImport + ISwaggerInfo.Create only for a document without external references (GetSwaggerInfo has no dependency override); a new client takes the bundled files.
Declared, not proven live: the O11 importer runs in the bridge (integration_import:openapi) on a detached copy of the module; the bridge loads with the next Service Studio opened.

capabilities.title: Expose a REST API: service, methods, URL inputs, typed outputs
capabilities.summary: IRestService under the module; IRestServiceAction under the service (born with Start and End) with HTTPMethod and URLPath; IRestServiceActionInput/IRestServiceActionOutput under the method (DataType, IsMandatory; on O11 also ReceiveIn/SendIn); the method body is logic (an Assign fills the output).

route.operation: op rest-expose {service, methods, remove} in one call (api --op rest-expose), or the raw verbs create/set of IRestService, IRestServiceAction and their inputs/outputs with the body nodes; deliver with studio_deliver / o11_deliver

capabilities.guidance: Addressing outside the creating job: IRestService:<Service> and IRestService:<Service>/<Method>. ODC (measured): renaming an exposed method rewrites its URLPath when the path contains the method name (the public URL changes) while rename reports consumers 0: external consumers are invisible to the model. The output type should be a public structure (data.structure, front A). The method body (Assign, calls) is logic owned by front A.
